This was the first video game I remember being "hyped" for. I read everything about it Nintendo Power, I had a preview VHS tape that I watched over and over. Then on top of that, I was literally the first person to rent the game at my local video store. They still had to unbox the games lol

items.text: Being the very first to rent a game you'd read everything about is a great memory. Majora's Mask has plenty of fans who'd say it was worth the wait.

Am I the only person who really likes the SNES 2/Jr and wishes some of these retro / FPGA clones would base their looks off *it*? SNES Jr feels like such a good compromise between the NA SNES and the JP SuFami / PAL SNES. The only thing it's missing is a little power LED.
image: Image of the 2nd revision North American Super Nintendo Entertainment System sitting next to the Japanese Super Famicom Jr. Unlike the original North American …
items.text: You're not the only one, the Jr's smaller, simpler shape has plenty of fans. It does feel like a nice middle ground between the other designs.
